How to use

Before adding a line to a map, global file or skill: does it fit under its limit, and does it earn its place ("would removing this cause a mistake?")? Lines are approximate (about 80 characters per line); characters are the real limit.
Who checks

repo-conform 2.3 checks the limits on this tab when it audits a project (checks L1 to L4, K4, K6, K17, K18, T5), and its speed pass (SP1–SP27) checks the AI files, Codex settings and recent chats. The tune-up (every 8 hours) checks AGENTS.md size, each SKILL.md size and active lessons (100 lines). Global files are built from ~/.agents/instructions; trim them there, then rebuild.
Confidence

Hard limits come from the tools' docs and installed programs (Claude Code 2.1.251, Codex 0.150.1). Our limits are judgment calls built on the tests; no study found a single "cliff" line count. Several sources are preprints. Full notes: master-connector-repo/work/2026-10-01_file-limits/notes/.
